grades: C = computed by this module (contrast ratios via the WCAG 2.x relative-luminance formula, script in the session scratchpad); P = proposed product choice; O = observed in competitor captures; U = unknown until built or tested

north_star.name: Naya bahi-khata (the modern ledger)
north_star.line_for_designers: A trusted desk in a well-run Indian office: warm paper, dark-green ink, a terracotta seal on what needs you, every call and every rupee written down honestly, and a colleague who has already done the work.
never: cliche Indian ornament (paisley borders, sitar stings)

operator_name.meaning: charioteer: drives so you can decide
operator_name.status: P; not trademark-cleared (evidence.brand-check is a preliminary screen only)
operator_name.reverse_if: 5-user sessions show users think Saarthi is a person or a separate product, or a brand screen finds a conflict

colour.rule: token-only; raw hex lives only in tokens.css; a lint bans colour literals elsewhere; one accent (terracotta) per screen region marks 'needs you'; status never by colour alone (icon + word)

contrast_C.bar: text pairs >= 5:1 (inherited Kaksha law, docs/harvest/tx-content-ui.md line 21), non-text component boundaries >= 3:1

type.ui_and_text: Anek Latin + Anek Devanagari (Ek Type; same family covers Bangla, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Tamil, Telugu for v3), OFL
type.mono: IBM Plex Mono (run manifests, codes, ids only)
type.lock_gate: type specimen test before lock: Hindi names with conjuncts (क्ष त्र ज्ञ श्र), nukta, stacked matras, Hinglish transcript lines, Indian digit grouping (1,24,500), the rupee sign U+20B9, tabular figures in tables; at 14/16/18 px on a mid Android and a 1280 laptop; owner signs by eye. If Anek fails tabular figures or Devanagari legibility at 14 px, switch UI to the fallback
rules: serif only for page titles, the Today masthead, big money and outcome numbers at 28 px or more; everything else sans
Devanagari runs: :lang(hi) at 1.06x the Latin size and line-height 1.65; never below 16 px for body
tables: tabular figures, right-aligned numbers, Indian grouping (en-IN)
line length 60-75 characters for prose; no visible text under 12 px; inputs 16 px on phone (no iOS zoom)
Relay's 13 px body and DM Sans are not reused (DESIGN.md; decision.product-ux-structural-reset-2026-10-01)

space_shape.elevation: hairline borders on paper; shadow only on floating layers (dock, sheet, toast): 0 12px 32px rgba(29,42,36,.12)
space_shape.grid_1280: rail 64 (collapsed) or 216 (expanded) + main + docked Talk 360; on Talk itself: rail 64 + thread 760 + Working-on pane 456
space_shape.grid_390: 16 px gutters, 358 px content, bottom tab bar 64 px (Today, Campaigns, Talk centre mic, Calls, More), safe-area insets
space_shape.targets: 44 px on touch, 32 px minimum on dense desktop tables
space_shape.icons: 1.5 px stroke rounded line set; custom glyphs: ring, waveform, rupee, ledger, seal (predicate), hand-off

motion.law: motion only shows the system working; nothing loops unless a real thing is happening

catalogue.motion: one concentric arc pulse every 1,200 ms on the call tile, opacity + scale <= 1.08
tile settles 180 ms; live two-lane level meter from real audio levels at 30 fps (4 Hz steps in reduced motion)
fade + rise 8 px, 180 ms; at most 3 staggered by 60 ms
bar driven by real counts (rows read, simulations done); never a fake indeterminate loop longer than 2 s without a text update
bars grow to real values over 400 ms; later updates tween 200 ms
old value strikes through, new value tints leaf then settles, 240 ms
ring fills around the button over 1,200 ms (the hold is the safety mechanism, workspace-tool-registry.json approval_token); early release reverses 120 ms
no rolling digits; value swaps with a 600 ms marigold tint

catalogue.event: milestone (first real ring, first verified outcome)
catalogue.motion: once per workspace, <= 800 ms, the ledger line inks in; no particles, no confetti (inherited juice limit, asset.tx-content-ui.juice-limits-module)

banned: skeleton shimmer longer than 2 s without text
auto-scrolling the transcript while the user is reading
motion.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion: every transition jumps to its end state; pulses become a static 'Ringing' badge; level meters step at 4 Hz; a test asserts parity of final states

budget.mission_control_frame_budget: 50 live tiles drawn on one canvas, script <= 4 ms per frame at 30 fps

sound.palette: soft mallet pluck with a santoor-like attack, no sitar, no ringtone imitation

cues.when: a call you are watching is answered by a person
cues.shape: two notes rising a perfect fourth

cues.when: a tap you made executed and a receipt came back
a new High or Critical issue or an approval addressed to you
cues.shape: two notes falling a minor third
cues.rate_limit: max 1 per 60 s; Critical crisis alerts also raise a system notification

rules: off until the person answers a one-time question after their first browser call ('Play a soft sound when a call connects or needs you?' with three preview buttons)
global mute in the header and in Settings; per-cue toggles
recordings and samples never autoplay; opening a call page plays nothing
one audio bus: starting any playback pauses the previous one; live listen ducks cues by 12 dB
no cues while the tab is hidden except Critical, which uses a system notification if permitted
each cue file Opus <= 8 KB, preloaded after the first user gesture

state_tokens.empty: explains the concept, offers one action
state_tokens.zero: a real zero with its reasons
state_tokens.loading: skeleton plus what is happening and how long
state_tokens.failed: names the cause, a retry and the status link
state_tokens.not_measured: the words 'not measured' and why; never 0, never a dash alone
state_tokens.under_powered: 'under-powered: about N more calls per group'
state_tokens.sample: diagonal SAMPLE watermark, a toggle, never mixed with real rows
state_tokens.stale: freshness stamp on every number ('updated 14 s ago')
state_tokens.redacted: masked by role, says who can see it
state_tokens.unsaved: dot on the version pill plus 'unsaved changes' text; leaving asks once
state_tokens.disabled_with_reason: the reason under the control and a Fix link; no silent disabled primary
state_tokens.locked_by_role: lock glyph, the role that can do it, 'Ask Priya (Owner)' action
state_tokens.vendor_says: figures a vendor publishes carry a 'vendor says' chip and never sit in the same column as measured ones

words.voice: plain, warm Indian English; Hinglish when the client writes Hinglish; Devanagari only when the client writes Devanagari

formats.money: ₹ with en-IN grouping, 'incl. GST' or '+ GST' always stated
formats.latency: ms below 10 s (1,480 ms), with p50/p90, n, date and vantage (server / handset / browser)
formats.time: 12-hour with am/pm and IST or the contact's local zone

patterns: What happened · why · what you can do [action]
lead with the answer, then the number, then the choice
one question at a time, with the default VP will use
banned: All good (unless monitors are live and read back)
self-learning / learns on its own / improves automatically below learning level L4 (learning-module-defaults.json copy_rules)
em-dash in visible copy (inherited copy gate)
AI-tell words: seamless, leverage, unlock, robust, elevate, delve
operator_rules: first person for its own work ('I mapped 1,240 rows')
receipts name the VP agent that acted ('by Data steward')
numbers only from page queries, never typed by the model
never asks for approval in words: a 'haan launch karo' renders the Launch card; only a tap approves

persona_catalogue_rules.enforced_in: voice catalogue ingest (code) plus a human review of every new voice; observed offenders: Sarvam 'Warm Night Companion', 'Therapist Voice'; Bolna 'Girlfriend Voice' (research/2026-10-21/walkthroughs/SYNTHESIS.md 2.5)
persona_catalogue_rules.voice_card_sample: the same Hinglish line in three registers; sample lines live in the catalogue and a compile lint refuses them inside any brief (sentence-shaped text gets recited)

gates: contrast gate in CI (both themes, all token pairs)
layout gate at 390 / 834 / 1280 px: chars per line, font floor, 44 px targets, no horizontal scroll (asset.hp-gurukul-late.secret-free-signed-in-layout-gate)
motion lint: transform/opacity only; reduced-motion parity
state-integrity crawler: 0 server writes from menu clicks or dropdowns, every disabled primary has a reason, 0 charts on n=0, 0 '0 ms' or '₹0' on empty data, 0 unlabelled sample rows
real-capture marketing: the public site only shows screens the app draws (asset.tx-content-ui.real-capture-marketing-site-pipeline)
